correctness.rationale: Inspected complete 99-tetrahedron verifier with f=(16,115,198,99). Its relation matrix after star-tree contraction has 100 generators and 198 face equations; 97 unimodular pivots and remaining one column with gcd2 certify SNF 1^97,2 and H1=Z²+Z/2. Two Z-cocycles surject to free quotient; independent mod2 cocycle detects unique torsion element. Exhaustive 495 three-cliques minus 198 faces leaves 297 nonfacial triangles, all nonzero; seven exact class counts 55,54,33,41,36,40,38. Every simple cycle >=3 edges, so all 297 are systoles. The finite verifier was read structurally, not executed as independent certificate.
